sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000067-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Evergreen Health Network 067 on April 1, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 5.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 50%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
